  "nda-7": {"label": "Entailment", "evidence": [{"span": [10]}], "text": "Span 10 explicitly allows disclosure to employees with 'need to have access' and to third parties with 'prior written consent of the party disclosing such confidential information'."},
  "nda-8": {"label": "Entailment", "evidence": [{"span": [22]}], "text": "The exceptions clause requires the Receiving Party to provide 'prior written notice of such obligation' and 'the opportunity to oppose such disclosure or obtain a protective order' when disclosure is compelled by law or judicial process (spans 22-23)."},

  "nda-12": {"label": "Entailment", "evidence": [{"span": [20]}], "text": "The exceptions clause includes '(iv) is independently developed by the Receiving Party without use of the Confidential Information' (span 20), permitting permissible development of similar information."},
